title: Out of a Space: The Elative Suffix -ból/-ből

sections.content:
The elative case (*-ból / -ből*) expresses movement **out of** an enclosed 3D space (such as a room, building, box, or country). Like other Hungarian cases, it obeys vowel harmony:
- Back vowel words take **-ból**: *szoba → szobából* (out of the room), *ház → házból* (out of the house), *bolt → boltból* (from the shop).
- Front vowel words take **-ből**: *kert → kertből* (out of the garden), *étterem → étteremből* (out of the restaurant), *épület → épületből* (out of the building).

items.english: I come out of the room.
Péter is coming from the shop right now.
The waiter comes out of the restaurant.

sections.content: Notice that final short -a lengthens to -á before suffixes: *iskola* (school) becomes *iskolából* (out of/from school).
